text: I feel a tight pressure on my chest, like something's crushing it.
My chest feels like an elephant is sitting on it.
Dada terasa berat banget, kayak ada beban gede.
Rasanya dada kayak diperas terus.
I can barely catch my breath, it's like I'm suffocating.
Breathing feels impossible, like the air is gone.
Susah napas banget, kayak nggak ada oksigen.
Napas terasa sesak parah, kayak tercekik.
My face feels numb on one side and my arm won't move.
I can't speak right, words are all jumbled.
Wajah sebelah terasa kebas, lengan gak bisa gerak.
Ngomongnya kayak kacau, kata-kata berantakan.
Someone just collapsed and won't wake up.
They’re unresponsive, eyes closed, no reaction.
Orang itu tiba-tiba jatuh, nggak bangun.
Dia nggak respons, mata tertutup, tidak ada reaksi.
They started shaking violently and couldn't control it.
Their body convulsed and they were unresponsive.
Mulai bergetar keras, nggak bisa mengendalikan diri.
Badannya berkonvulsi, tidak sadar.
Blood is pouring out and won't stop despite pressure.
There's a big wound bleeding nonstop.
Darah mengalir deras, tidak berhenti meski ditekan.
Luka besar terus berdarah tanpa henti.
I vomited dark red stuff, looks like blood.
My stool is black and tarry, looks like coffee grounds.
Muntahnya berwarna merah gelap, kayak darah.
Tinja hitam pekat, seperti ampas kopi.
I keep thinking I don't want to live anymore.
I feel like there's no way out and I'm done.
Rasanya hidup ini nggak ada harapan lagi.
Aku merasa semua sudah berakhir, nggak mau lagi.
My throat feels like it's closing up, I can’t swallow.
My mouth is swelling fast, it's hard to breathe.
Tenggorokan terasa menyempit, susah menelan.
Mulut bengkak cepat, napas terasa terhambat.
A sudden, excruciating pain hit my head out of nowhere.
My head is pounding like a hammer, unbearable.
Sakit kepala tiba-tiba luar biasa keras.
Kepala terasa dipukul palu, tidak tertahankan.
I feel totally disoriented, can't think straight.
Everything feels fuzzy, I don't know what's happening.
Aku bingung banget, pikiran kacau.
Semua terasa kabur, nggak tahu apa yang terjadi.
I think I swallowed something toxic, I'm feeling sick.
After taking too many pills, I feel dizzy and nauseous.
Kayaknya aku menelan racun, badan terasa sakit.
Setelah minum terlalu banyak obat, pusing dan mual.
My stomach hurts intensely, like a stabbing pain.
I have a sharp, unbearable pain in my abdomen.
Perut terasa sakit luar biasa, seperti ditusuk.
Ada rasa sakit tajam yang tak tertahankan di perut.
